_real_world.class: AN/SQR-19 TACTAS or TB-37U MFTA passive towed array (SQQ-89A(V)15 backfit)
_real_world.variant_scope: Per-hull towed-array fit is not public (R18); this record represents the newer TB-37U fit used for DDG-96 (Flight IIA); DDG-72 Mahan uses the older SQR-19 (see the Flight II ship record's _real_world note).

_provenance.modeling_note: Passive towed-array sonar with a longer baseline and lower self-noise than the hull-mounted sonar, per the higher directivity_gain_db and lower self_noise_per_speed_db/ambient_noise_db proxies. No public detection ranges exist for either SQR-19 or TB-37U (R18); range and noise fields are engineering estimates scaled up from the repo's passive hull-sonar MVP calibration to reflect a towed array's typically longer effective range versus a hull-mounted array, not authoritative TB-37U performance.

sonar.mode.note: SQR-19/TB-37U towed arrays are passive listening systems

sonar.max_range_m.note: no public figure (R18); scaled up ~2x from the hull-sonar MVP baseline to reflect a towed array's longer baseline/lower self-noise advantage, engineering estimate

sonar.scan_period_s.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo passive hull-sonar MVP baseline

sonar.detection_threshold_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate slightly better than the hull-sonar MVP baseline, reflecting a towed array's lower self-noise

sonar.track_memory_s.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo passive hull-sonar MVP baseline

sonar.bearing_noise_std_deg.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo passive hull-sonar MVP baseline

sonar.range_noise_std_m.note: no public figure; engineering estimate scaled up with the larger max_range_m

sonar.directivity_gain_db.note: engineering estimate: towed line arrays have higher directivity gain than a hull-mounted bow array

sonar.self_noise_per_speed_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate better than the hull-sonar MVP baseline, reflecting the towed array's distance from ownship machinery noise

sonar.ambient_noise_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate slightly better than the hull-sonar MVP baseline

sonar.source_level_reference_db.note: 0.0: passive-only array, no active source level applies

sonar.source_level_speed_factor_db.note: 0.0: passive-only array, no active source-level speed dependency

sonar.transmission_loss_alpha_db_per_km.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo passive hull-sonar MVP baseline (generic underwater transmission-loss constant)

sonar.layer_break_penalty_db.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo passive hull-sonar MVP baseline

sonar.convergence_zone_bonus_m.note: no public figure; engineering estimate scaled with max_range_m

sonar.baffle_exclusion_deg.note: 0.0: towed array trails well astern of the hull's own baffles, unlike a hull-mounted array

sonar.ownship_quieting_speed_mps.note: no public figure; engineering estimate slightly above the hull-sonar MVP baseline, reflecting a towed array's reduced flow-noise sensitivity

sonar.active_ping_source_level_db.note: 0.0: passive-only array, no active ping capability modeled

sonar.confirm_hits_m.note: standard engine detection-confirmation default, not sourced per-platform

sonar.confirm_window_n.note: standard engine detection-confirmation default, not sourced per-platform

sonar.passive_only.note: SQR-19/TB-37U towed arrays have no active transmit mode

sonar.bearing_only.note: false: modern towed arrays support range estimation via multi-array triangulation/TMA, not bearing-only
